samples.question: The wide horizontal strip is a tape of colored cells. The framed panel below it shows exactly three neighboring tape cells, in their original left-to-right order, reproduced at twice their size on the tape; nothing else was changed. Four triangles above the tape each point down at one cell. Every one of those four pointed cells has the same color as the middle cell of the framed panel, so the middle color alone cannot tell them apart; only one of the four pointed cells also has the framed panel's left color on its left and its right color on its right. Which triangle points at the middle cell of the framed panel? Answer with that triangle's color: orange, brown, teal, or navy.
